selection_method: Purposeful coverage-constrained selection from scored-correct Dev originals; exact IDs and edits are fixed for review. Not a random representative sample.
difficulty_design: One proposed clear/moderate/subtle case per target, assigned before perturbed scoring; Leader may revise labels before freezing. These are design judgements, not measured difficulty.

detection_scoring_proposal.adaptation: The selected criterion is fail; report other-criterion changes.
detection_scoring_proposal.correctness: The existing correctness rubric yields score below 2.
detection_scoring_proposal.evidence_support: A factual claim covering the added subclaim is bundle_support unsupported. Omitting the subclaim or marking it supported/not_applicable is not detection.
detection_scoring_proposal.unresolved: Keep in the denominator as not detected and report separately.

interpretation: Targeted sensitivity examples, not population judge accuracy.
